page.overview:
What is Cerulean Cave?

Cerulean Cave is in the northwest of Cerulean City in the Kanto region. However, unlike most other locations, this treacherous dungeon is heavily restricted by the Pokémon League; By default, there is a non-playable character blocking the entrance to Cerulean Cave, since entering it requires one to be victorious at the Indigo Plateau League, meaning they must first be the Pokémon Champion and enter the Hall of Fame (implying even Gym Leaders and Elite Four members are disallowed). In , this goes even farther in that one has to also complete the Sevii Islands quest. This is because Cerulean Cave is filled with rather high-leveled wild Pokémon between 40s to 60s depending on the game, and Mewtwo, a notoriously powerful -type Legendary Pokémon and artificial clone of Mew, is hidden at the deepest part of the dungeon, at level 70, making it extremely dangerous and therefore forbidden for the average Pokémon Trainer.

Notably, in each of its appearances, the maze-like layout of the cave itself is different. While the original map from would be reused for their Generation III and VII remakes with the addition of breakable rocks, and have unique designs.

In Generation II, the entrance to Cerulean Cave is flooded by water. A Hiker in Cerulean City tells the player character that a nearby cave, referring to Cerulean Cave, has caved in recently. The Berserk Gene is one of the more notable items that can be obtained. In , it has been rebuilt using the general layouts from Yellow and (basement and upper floors, respectively), but can only be entered after obtaining all 16 Gym Badges. Once again, Mewtwo can be encountered.

In Pokémon Origins, the cave makes an appearance in "File 4: Charizard", where it was first mentioned by Blue after hearing rumors of an incredibly strong Pokémon living inside, but he was easily defeated while attempting to capture it, with his Blastoise sent flying and crashing on top of him, leaving the former Champion badly injured. Soon after, when Professor Oak and Red learned about the dungeon from the journals found at Cinnabar Island, it was revealed that the mysterious but deadly Pokémon was in fact Mewtwo. In a fierce battle, even Red himself was almost defeated, but eventually captures Mewtwo upon using Mega Evolution on his Charizard to become Mega Charizard X.
